idea.description: Train one NextItNet per category using uncorrected sampled-candidate cross-entropy on complete training prefixes plus a weak auxiliary copy on recent suffixes. Both branches share every model parameter, target, and candidate set. Deploy one complete-prefix forward pass from exactly one checkpoint per category. Position this as a targeted training regularizer with close supervised-cropping precedents, rather than a novel intent-identification mechanism.
idea.motivation: The user diagnosis identifies stale-interest persistence and broad-purpose recommendations outranking specific immediate matches. Recent-suffix supervision explicitly targets these two failures by encouraging the same target to remain predictable from recent evidence; success is uncertain because recent histories can be ambiguous and older preferences can remain useful. Multi-negative competition targets Electronics' measured separation weakness: 12.27% negative-over-positive positions and a −0.2595 tenth-percentile margin. Neither mechanism establishes purchase purpose, compatibility, satisfied needs, or duplication avoidance. Embedding similarity scores near 0.5 do not justify an embedding-collapse intervention. At 0% progress, a controlled objective change is more feasible than adding text encoders or timestamp-dependent inference inputs.
idea.implementation_notes:
The corrected baseline source is absent from the supplied material. Consequently, this is an integration specification, not a claim that an executable train.py or complete reproduction configuration has been supplied. Before implementation, obtain the baseline's architecture, optimizer, batch size, sequence length, precision, sampler behavior, validation schedule, and checkpoint rule from the host-supplied source, without inspecting other trials. Preserve these settings unless explicitly varied and record their concrete values. No training or new validation results are claimed.

Retain the NextItNet causal dilated residual convolution backbone. Calculate receptive-field width from every actual temporal convolution: R = 1 + sum((kernel_size−1)*dilation) for stride one. Do not assume two same-dilation convolutions per block: the original implementation uses d and 2d, contributing 3*(kernel_size−1)*d per block. Start with suffix length s=8 when 1 < s < R and training prefixes actually exceed s. If R<=8, use s=max(1,R−1); if R<=1, reject this contextual intervention as inapplicable. Record the realized R and fraction of eligible positions with more than s prefix items. For deterministic, padding-safe, positionwise-normalized causal computation, suffixes at least as long as R reproduce the same reachable final context, so they do not test historical exclusion. Cropping is a training intervention, not evidence of preference drift.

Use uncorrected sampled-candidate cross-entropy deliberately: CE = −positive_logit + logsumexp(positive_logit, negative_logits), temperature 1. Do not label it importance-corrected sampled softmax. Initially use K=16, auxiliary coefficient 0.25, and the suffix rule above. Treat these as prespecified proposals, not measured optima. For user u, define eligible catalog IDs by excluding padding 0, the current target, and all known training-history positives; never use validation or test labels. Let M_u be the eligible-set size and sample K_u=min(16,M_u) distinct items uniformly without replacement. Use the same candidates for a position's complete and suffix branches. Mask unused candidate slots to negative infinity. Skip positions with M_u=0 and report their count; skip optimizer steps with no usable positions. Average CE once over valid prediction positions, without dividing again by negative count. User-specific exclusions intentionally change support, and future positives remain unknown.

An optional, separately identified future control is importance-corrected sampled softmax over the positive plus eligible set. For that control only, add log(M_u/K_u) to each sampled negative logit and leave the deterministic positive unchanged. This follows inclusion probability K_u/M_u for uniform sampling without replacement. Subtracting one common correction from every candidate cancels and is incorrect for that estimator. An unbiased partition estimate does not make the finite-sample log loss or its gradients unbiased. Do not silently mix corrected and uncorrected objectives or change sampling design through post-hoc deduplication.

Keep the baseline's valid target positions: a target at training position t follows sequence[t] and must never appear as a shifted input to its own prediction. Compute the main loss over all usable positions. For the auxiliary pass, uniformly select without replacement up to B usable positions from the current B×L batch, using a dedicated training RNG seeded 42. For each selected position, construct its input prefix ending at t, retain the last s nonpadding items, and left-pad to the baseline sequence length. Average auxiliary CE over selected positions, then apply coefficient 0.25. This bounds auxiliary processing to approximately one additional baseline-sized sequence batch and avoids a B×L×L expansion. It remains additional compute; measure runtime rather than assuming a fixed overhead. Use ordinary training-mode dropout with independent masks across the two calls. When contexts coincide, independent dropout can still change optimization; do not attribute that effect to cropping.

Keep full-prefix inference. Do not add a last-item scoring shortcut, independently fitted text or transition head, or separate popularity scores. Preserve any supplied jointly trained baseline components and document them; if an explicit last-item shortcut exists, its ablation is a separate trial, never an inference fusion. Use left-only causal padding and channel-wise normalization. Keep padding embeddings zero and mask padded states before temporal convolutions and after each convolutional sublayer and block; otherwise biased padding states can contaminate subsequent valid activations. Select the actual final nonpadding position by positional maximum, never count−1. Follow the corrected baseline's explicit empty-history policy without accidental index −1 access.

Prespecify comparison order: corrected baseline, original-only candidate CE, then full-plus-suffix candidate CE. If resources remain, test suffix-only supervision and same-target random contiguous cropping, checking that all crop inputs precede their target. Contrastive augmentation is a lower-priority comparison because it introduces another objective and more tuning. These are separate trials, never combined at prediction. Log GPU seconds, optimizer steps, processed positions, parameters, peak allocated memory, and every validation query. For controlled ablations use the same prespecified GPU-time allowance, hardware, validation schedule, and checkpoint rule; also report realized updates because equal updates and equal compute cannot generally both hold. A control terminated by a time cap is not an equal-epoch comparison. Account for all training, diagnostics, debugging, and failed trials within 43,200 GPU-seconds; do not assume every optional control will fit.

Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, 200 batches per epoch, single-GPU execution, all four categories and dataset routing, supplied splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and artifacts beneath the trial directory. Select exclusively by host macro validation HR@10 using the pinned 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed 42. The prior reported combined_score=0.5500 is contextual evidence only; no paired improvement or uncertainty estimate is supplied. With 200 users/category, one additional hit changes category HR by 0.005 and macro HR by 0.00125. Repeated validation-based selection can overfit; keep the initial configuration and comparison order fixed, log every query, and avoid an open-ended sweep over suffix lengths, coefficients, negative counts, or temperatures. Freeze the selected configuration before the separate held-out evaluation.

Retain ModelView.model as the actual trained nn.Module and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returning metrics and metric_definitions, and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). The diagnostic loader remains (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B×L tensors. Measure margins using that loader's supplied negatives, valid target positions, and deployed complete-prefix scoring, separately from training candidates. Define embedding-collapse measurements over the ID embedding table as before. Mark item-category breakdowns unavailable because category metadata are unavailable; do not infer product classes from dataset routing or empty breakdowns.

For inexpensive context diagnostics, compare full, last-item, and suffix inputs of lengths 2, 4, 8, and 16 on a fixed diagnostic sample, deduplicating equivalent lengths and respecting available history. Replace or shuffle older valid items while preserving the recent suffix; separately shuffle the suffix while preserving the last item. Define and report score/rank changes on identical candidates. Similar full and last-item outputs suggest limited measured dependence on older inputs, not proof of intent or absence of long-term preferences. Perturbations can cause distribution shift and are not retrained ablations. Obtain perturbed validation HR or history-length breakdowns only if the unchanged host evaluator already supports those requests; otherwise report them unavailable and keep perturbation measurements within diagnostics. Do not modify the host evaluator.

Continue the native twenty-user unseen-item recommendation diagnosis, five real training users per category. Track reported stale-interest and broad-purpose rejections, preference for lower-ranked specific matches, and uncertain item identity separately; do not invent quantitative rates from qualitative summaries. Other reported duplication and compatibility failures remain unresolved limitations. Use only permitted histories, timestamps, item titles, and descriptions; this experiment needs no metadata inputs. Reviews, ratings, prices, stores, item-category metadata, pretrained weights, and simulator diversity/conformity traits are unavailable.

Update the embedded predictor writer with exactly the trained model definition, architecture configuration, normalization, checkpoint keys, and padding policy. Load one independently trained checkpoint per category. Check reload score agreement in evaluation mode on fixed synthetic and permitted training examples, causal invariance to future inputs, prefix-target alignment, finite loss for variable negative counts, and the empty-history path. Keep these checks small and charge their resource use to the search budget. The auxiliary loss introduces no inference branch or independent model.
idea.pseudocode:
R = 1 + sum((conv.kernel_size - 1) * conv.dilation
            for conv in actual_stride_one_temporal_convolutions)
assert R > 1
suffix_length = 8 if R > 8 else max(1, R - 1)
auxiliary_rng = seeded_rng(42)
negative_rng = seeded_rng(42)

for batch in baseline_sample_batch(seed=42):
    sequence, positive, diagnostic_negative = unpack(batch)
    # Retain the baseline's batch-to-user mapping internally.
    positions = valid_target_positions(sequence, positive)
    positions = remove_positions_with_no_eligible_negatives(positions)
    if len(positions) == 0:
        continue

    candidates, candidate_mask = [], []
    for position in positions:
        u = baseline_user_for_position(position)
        eligible = catalog_ids_excluding(
            padding=0, target=positive[position],
            training_positives=user_training_history[u])
        M = len(eligible)
        K_u = min(16, M)
        negatives = uniform_without_replacement(eligible, K_u, negative_rng)
        candidates.append([positive[position]] + negatives)
    candidates, candidate_mask = pad_candidate_rows(candidates)

    full_features = model.log2feats(sequence)
    logits = model.predict_score(full_features[positions], candidates)
    logits = logits.masked_fill(~candidate_mask, -inf)
    main_loss = cross_entropy(logits, target_column=0, reduction='mean')
    # Intentionally uncorrected sampled-candidate CE, temperature=1.
    # No extra division by K; no sampling-probability correction.

    selected = uniform_subset_without_replacement(
        positions, count=min(sequence.shape[0], len(positions)),
        rng=auxiliary_rng)
    suffixes = left_padded_recent_prefixes(
        sequence, end_positions=selected,
        max_nonpadding_items=suffix_length,
        output_length=sequence.shape[1])
    # A selected target never appears in its own input prefix.
    suffix_features = model.log2feats(suffixes)
    valid = suffixes.ne(0)
    last = where(valid, arange(suffixes.shape[1]), -1).amax(dim=1)
    assert all(last >= 0)
    suffix_logits = model.predict_score(
        suffix_features[arange(len(selected)), last],
        candidates_for(selected))
    suffix_logits = suffix_logits.masked_fill(
        ~candidate_mask_for(selected), -inf)
    auxiliary_loss = cross_entropy(
        suffix_logits, target_column=0, reduction='mean')
    optimizer_step(main_loss + 0.25 * auxiliary_loss)

# Prediction: exactly one full-prefix forward pass and checkpoint/category.
model.eval()
features = model.log2feats(sequence)
last = where(sequence.ne(0), arange(sequence.shape[1]), -1).amax(dim=1)
nonempty = last.ge(0)
scores[nonempty] = model.predict_score(
    features[nonempty, last[nonempty]], candidates[nonempty])
scores[~nonempty] = corrected_baseline_empty_history_policy(...)
# Export the identical architecture/configuration and verify reload agreement.
# Keep pinned host evaluation, routing, and checkpoint selection unchanged.

originality.positive: The proposal combines recent-suffix supervision and multi-negative candidate discrimination in a tightly constrained, diagnosis-motivated NextItNet experiment.
originality.negative: Supervised cropping has direct precedent in CL4SRec's augmentation controls, and SSS4SR explicitly supports suffix samples. Shared encoding and subsequence supervision alone offer little methodological novelty.

future_potential.positive: A controlled study can clarify when recent-context regularization improves ranking without extra inference models, and whether effects differ by receptive field or history length.
future_potential.negative: The intervention may reproduce established augmentation effects, discard useful long-term evidence, or improve optimization without addressing immediate purpose. A broader contribution would require evidence beyond this benchmark.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing NextItNet architecture and scoring interface can be reused, and inference remains a single forward pass.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct per-user sampling support, prefix-target alignment, padding-safe convolutions, bounded auxiliary computation, compute-matched controls, and predictor consistency require careful integration. Missing baseline source prevents a complete drop-in implementation specification.

report:
**Evidence and insights.** The starting point supports three insights. (1) NextItNet supplies causal features across its receptive field; depth gates alone cannot establish stale-history exclusion. Compute that field from actual convolutions before selecting a suffix. (2) Users reject broad-purpose matches and persistent older interests. Recent-prefix supervision targets both as hypotheses; purpose, compatibility, and satisfied needs remain unobserved. (3) Electronics has 12.27% sampled ranking errors and a −0.2595 lower-tail margin. This motivates discrimination improvements; embedding similarities near 0.5 do not establish collapse.

Related work supplies three insights. (1) [Wu et al.](https://wujcan.github.io/papers/tois-ssm.pdf) motivate multi-negative competition, but transfer to NextItNet requires testing. (2) [Prakash et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276) show dataset-dependent sampling effects; [UFNRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.04116) warns that unobserved items can be false negatives. (3) [CL4SRec](https://arxiv.org/html/2010.14395v2) includes supervised cropping controls, and [SSS4SR](https://github.com/KingGugu/SSS4SR) supports suffix supervision. These substantially limit originality.

**Framework.** Three directions form a context × discrimination × information matrix: depth aggregation changes context representation; multi-negative learning changes discrimination; text conditioning adds permitted semantics. The selected experiment combines context regularization and discrimination without inventing compatibility labels.

**Candidate assessment.** Scores are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty; difficulty increases with effort. Each dimension includes a positive (+) and limitation (−).

| Idea | Scores | Critical assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Uniform multi-negative candidate CE [Wu] | 2/7/5/8/3 | O: +focused adaptation, −established; P: +scalable, −sampler-sensitive; U: +specific competition, −no recency intervention; M: +separation, −margins differ from HR; D: +small change, −exclusion overhead. |
| Recent-prefix paired candidate CE [CL4SRec; SSS4SR] | 2/6/8/8/5 | O: +targeted combination, −close precedents; P: +tests context regularization, −limited novelty; U: +stale/broad-purpose targets, −intent unobserved; M: +negative competition, −false negatives remain; D: +shared network, −alignment/compute controls. |
| Joint title encoder [Recformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13731) inspiration | 3/6/7/5/7 | O: +convolutional adaptation, −fusion established; P: +semantics, −sparse text; U: +functional cues, −fit unverified; M: +differentiation, −benefit uncertain; D: +available text, −export complexity. |

**Selected experiment: recent-prefix paired candidate CE.** At 0% progress, retain this feasible regularizer, while testing original-only candidate CE first. Use one shared NextItNet on full prefixes and recent suffixes with identical targets/candidates: `loss = mean(full_CE) + 0.25 * mean(suffix_CE)`. Start with eight-item suffixes only if shorter than the actual receptive field. Draw up to 16 distinct uniform negatives excluding training positives, target, and padding. This deliberately uses uncorrected sampled-candidate CE, not importance-corrected sampled softmax.

Use full-history inference and one checkpoint/category. Compare baseline, original-only CE, and paired CE separately under matched compute; suffix-only and random-crop controls follow only if budget permits. Check last-item shortcut dependence and suffix sensitivity without interpreting perturbations as intent evidence. Preserve seeds, limits, routing, diagnostic contracts, and predictor consistency. Select solely by pinned macro validation HR@10; margins and twenty-user feedback remain supporting evidence.
